Hurricane Isaias causes two deaths in Florida

Hurricane Isaias made landfall on Florida's panhandle late on Friday as a category 2 hurricane. The storm has since weakened to a post-tropical cyclone. Two people have died due to falling trees. Nearly one million people are without power, and concerns remain about rain and flooding.
